trans-unit.source: RatingStar
Profile slug of the branch

The part after /t/ in the address of your RatingStar profile. Add the domain of this website in your RatingStar account under “Siegel & Widgets → Domains & Statistik” and confirm it with the DNS record shown there (TXT _ratingstar.your-domain). As soon as a domain is confirmed there, RatingStar delivers the seal data to confirmed domains only.
Group (slug)

Only for the seal of a whole group across all branches: the part after /g/ in the address of the group. If filled in, the seals of this website show the group instead of the branch. The domain is then approved in the group back end under “Siegel & Widgets → Domains & Statistik”, and the API key to enter is the key of the group.
API key

Starts with rs_live_, followed by 40 characters. You find it in your RatingStar account on the page “Google-Sterne”. It is needed for the Google stars and stays valid when the slug changes. After rotating the key in your RatingStar account, enter the new one here.
Output Google stars (JSON-LD)

Writes your company as structured data into the head of every page – the basis for stars in the Google search. Requires the API key; rating and number of reviews are included from the 4-Star plan. Your server fetches the data and keeps it for 6 hours, so the browser of your visitors needs no connection to RatingStar for this.
RatingStar address

Leave empty for the standard address (shown in the field). The browser of your visitors loads the script, styles, rating data and a counting pixel of the seals from this address. Name it in your privacy policy and take it into account in your consent tool.
The API key starts with rs_live_ followed by exactly 40 letters or digits.
Please enter the address without a path, for example https://reviews.example.com.
The Google stars still need the API key. Without it no structured data is output.
